blind.description: A rectangular raised garden soil plot planted with crops. It features a dark brown tilled earth mound/bed with four to five rows of vegetables, including pale green cabbages and red/white root vegetables (radishes or turnips) with leafy green tops. The style is clean, stylized low-to-mid poly with solid, smooth geometric surfaces and no detached or hovering fragments.
blind.from_above: A vertically oriented rectangular dark brown plot filled with rows of round green cabbage heads down the center and reddish-pink radishes with green leaves along the perimeter and interior spaces.
blind.height_vs_figure: Very low to the ground, only about 0.8 to 1 foot tall (under one-fifth the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure); approximately 3 feet wide and 6 feet long (roughly as long as the figure is tall).
